rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The identified_bias_summary contains four labels with one occurrence each, matching the four identified_occurrences records. Candidate records are separately represented and do not belong in the identified summary.

evaluation_limitations: The RAG output uses near-neighbor taxonomy labels rather than the hidden benchmark labels, so label equivalence and mechanism overlap require adjudication.
No retrieved chunks, source passages, or retrieval logs were supplied; corpus fidelity is not scored.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The throughput report just carried more weight for me.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Selective weighting of confirming throughput evidence over the disconfirming vibration advisory during the Press 3 allocation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The pattern matched what I'd seen twice before with this supplier, so I expected a similar resolution.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The current supplier delay was causally attributed to a superficial temporal pattern observed in prior delays.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I called the first person on my list rather than shopping around.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The first acceptable backup-supplier option was selected without comparative evaluation under time pressure.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Pulling three weeks of data might have shown a clearer upward line ... and that could have meant reworking Friday's plan.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The available vibration trend log was not reviewed partly because it might have forced rescheduling.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I was thinking of the Press 1 fire from a couple years ago ... This didn't look anything like that, so it didn't register as urgent.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Risk severity was judged against the vivid recalled fire rather than the gradual vibration trend.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The earlier data ... still felt like the more solid read ... so I didn't weight the new label as heavily.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: New elevated-concern evidence was underweighted relative to the previously formed throughput-based belief.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 1: allocation of the extra bracket batch to Press 3
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Selective weighting of confirming throughput data over disconfirming vibration advisory during capacity allocation
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring effect is related to, but not an approved equivalent of, Confirmation Bias; the candidate describes a possible anchor but does not use the hidden target label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The candidate identifies underweighting of the vibration advisory relative to the concrete throughput report in the allocation decision, which fully captures the hidden evidence-weighting mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The supporting quote is valid and directly overlaps the mapped segment.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 2: selection of a backup-supplier contact
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Satisficing selection of the first acceptable backup-supplier option under time pressure without comparative evaluation
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Default bias/status quo bias is not an approved equivalent of Bounded Rationality. The candidate's alternative label satisficing is related to the hidden mechanism but is not the proposed primary label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The candidate captures reliance on a known contact and lack of comparison, but it frames the behavior as default reliance and does not fully establish first-acceptable-option satisficing as the operative mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The supporting quote is valid and directly overlaps the mapped supplier-selection segment; the limitation is classification specificity, not evidence fabrication.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 2: interpretation of the primary supplier's four-day delay
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Causal misattribution of current delay to a seasonal pattern observed in unrelated past delays
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Representativeness heuristic and sample-size neglect are related to the causal-pattern error, but they are not approved aliases for the hidden Correlation bias label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures causal attribution of the current delay to superficial timing similarity from two prior delays while discounting the stated cause, with the correct forecasting/causal reasoning operation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The long supplier-delay quote is valid, correctly attributed, and substantively overlaps the mapped segment.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 4: final schedule adjustment after the elevated-concern update
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Underweighting of new elevated-concern status relative to previously formed belief that Press 3 is reliable
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring effect overlaps with insufficient adjustment but is not an approved equivalent of Conservatism Bias in this benchmark.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures persistence of the earlier throughput-based belief and insufficient updating in response to the new expert risk signal, including the correct belief-updating operation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The supporting quote is valid, correctly attributed, and directly overlaps the finalization segment.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 3: severity assessment of the Press 3 vibration increase
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Risk severity judgment anchored on vividness of a recalled past dramatic incident rather than actual gradual trend data
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is a related salience-based construct but is not treated as an approved equivalent of the hidden Imaginability Bias label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures using the vivid Press 1 fire as the severity reference and discounting the gradual trend because the current issue did not resemble that exemplar.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The supporting quote is valid, correctly attributed, and directly overlaps the mapped severity-assessment segment.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 3: decision not to review the full vibration trend log
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Avoidance of requesting/reviewing available risk-relevant information to prevent exposure to information that could force rescheduling
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Information avoidance is closely related to the Ostrich effect, but the broader label is not treated as an approved equivalent in this ontology-free adjudication.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures deliberately not obtaining available trend information partly because it could reveal a worsening pattern and force schedule rework.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The supporting quote is valid, correctly attributed, and directly overlaps the mapped information-avoidance segment.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The quote is valid and correctly localized, but default reliance is not the hidden Bounded Rationality label or full first-acceptable-option satisficing mechanism. It is therefore a fourth-threshold false positive in both instance scorecards.

candidates.details: The candidate's quote and stated mechanism fully capture the hidden selective weighting of throughput evidence over the vibration advisory, but anchoring effect is a near-neighbor label rather than the exact Confirmation Bias label.

The candidate identifies a real no-comparison choice under time pressure, but its proposed default-reliance mechanism does not fully establish the hidden satisficing mechanism for Bounded Rationality.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No identified finding has high confidence, so all six positive segments are missed.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: The two moderate-confidence findings detect the supplier-delay and vivid-incident segments; four positive segments remain undetected.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: All four identified occurrences localize to positive segments; the two allocation and backup-selection segments are covered only by candidates.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Both candidates localize to the two remaining positive segments, giving complete segment coverage; no negative segments were available for false-alarm testing.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full overlap with causal attribution to a superficial temporal pattern; the taxonomy label differs.
Full overlap with motivated avoidance of available negative or decision-disruptive information; the primary label is broader.
Full overlap with vivid-exemplar-driven severity judgment; availability heuristic is not an approved target-label equivalent.
Full overlap with insufficient updating after a new risk signal; anchoring and Conservatism Bias remain distinct labels here.
The candidate's mechanism fully matches the allocation-stage evidence weighting, but the label is a near neighbor and it remains candidate-status.
Partial overlap with no-comparison supplier selection under time pressure, without a full satisficing mechanism.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly reports that no retrieved corpus passages were used and leaves corpus_evidence empty. No retrieval fidelity score is calculated.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase by 2 and mechanism-first instance true positives increase by 2, while strict instance false positives increase from 0 to 2.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Segment hits increase by 2 and mechanism-first instance true positives increase by 2 through low-confidence findings; strict false positives increase from 2 to 4.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Candidate inclusion adds 2 segment hits, one mechanism-first true positive, one mechanism-first false positive, and two strict false positives.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: All six eligible segments are positive. Segment detection is 0/6 at high-only, 2/6 at high-and-moderate, 4/6 with all identified findings, and 6/6 when candidates are included; false-alarm rates are undefined because there are no negative segments.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: There are no strict true positives at any threshold: the four identified findings use near-neighbor labels, and neither candidate supplies an exact target label.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring credits four identified findings at the all-identified threshold. Candidate cand_001 adds a fifth mechanism-first true positive at the fourth threshold; cand_002 remains a near miss.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Candidate inclusion recovers one additional mechanism-first instance but also adds one mechanism-first false positive, while both candidates increase segment coverage because both localize to positive segments.
main_failure_modes: Systematic taxonomy mismatch: all four identified labels are related but not approved equivalents of the hidden target labels.
Confidence calibration is conservative: two correctly localized mechanism matches are low confidence and are absent from the recommended high-and-moderate threshold.
The backup-supplier candidate does not distinguish default reliance from the hidden satisficing mechanism strongly enough for instance-level credit.
main_strengths: All four identified occurrences use valid, directly supportive interview quotations.
The four identified mechanisms are correctly localized and substantively capture the corresponding hidden reasoning distortions.
The RAG discloses that corpus support was unavailable and includes relevant non-bias caveats.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run demonstrates a large taxonomy gap: strict label-plus-mechanism scoring is zero despite strong evidence fidelity, whereas mechanism-first scoring reaches F1 0.8000 for identified findings and 0.8333 when the candidate tier is included.
